eps.ov: Fushi awakens in a world where peace reigns. What new and old encounters await him?
Fushi begins his new life in the present day and begins to gather his former classmates at Yuki's house.
Mizuha is fed up with her everyday life and decides to run away.
Fushi takes care of a troubled Mizuha.
Fushi and his revived friends joins Yuki and Mizuha at school.
Fushi struggles to maintain the peace between Tonari and Mizuha.
The mystery of the Nokker inside Mimori is clarified a little, as it seeks Fushi at the school to attack him.
Hirotoshi reveals Mimori's deeply troubled past.
Fushi and Bon try to save Mimori at Hirotoshi's request, but a new Nokker appears.
Rikuya is found destroyed. The Nokkers confront Fushi.
Fushi has an opportunity to deal with the Nokker in Izumi's body.
Fushi transforms into small creatures to keep an eye on Mizuha and Funa. Meanwhile, Eko gives Yuki an idea.
Fushi goes back to school, but as Fuuna. He learns about what people really think.
Gugu confesses to being homesick. Fushi struggles to come to terms with his friends growing distant.
Bon describes how Fushi's friends spent their time after he went to sleep centuries prior.
Fushi and his friends look for ways to get back in touch with Mizuha.
Fushi tries desperately to negotiate with Mizuha. Meanwhile, an impostor attacks the school.
Tonari, Aiko and their schoolmates fight the Fushi impostor.
Yuki and the crew negotiate a peace with the Guardians.
Fushi and his friends return to Yuki's place to discuss how they should avoid being arrested.
The class needs to decide what they're doing after middle school. Fushi's decision is much weightier.
The Beholder leaves Fushi with a memo.
